curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can the ninja team manage the demanding, materialistic royal family without walking away like every escort before them?
curatedMovie.description: Naruto, Kakashi, Sakura, and Rock Lee are tasked with protecting Michiru, the lavish prince of the wealthy Land of the Moon, on an international journey after previous escorts quit over poor treatment.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, light, and exciting animated action that keeps you engaged across a colorful, globetrotting mission.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Toshiyuki Tsuru, this lively anime adventure combines high-energy team dynamics with a breezy, fast-paced quest that is easy to enjoy with family or friends.

facts.title: Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom
